description: This file defines a React functional component named EditorSidebar, which provides a UI sidebar with editing tools such as crop, resize, rotate, filters, and adjustments for an image editor application. It also includes a ToolButton subcomponent for rendering individual buttons with icons and labels.

methods.description: React component rendering a button with icon and label, configurable with onClick handler and disabled state.
